name: AR400
test_method: Brinell HBW per ASTM A370 on a milled or ground surface 0.5-3.0 mm below plate surface; Charpy V-notch, longitudinal, 19 mm plate, typical value (not guaranteed)
notes: Nominal 400 HBW. Charpy published as 25 ft-lb at -40 F; converted at 1 ft-lbf = 1.355818 J (33.9 J) and -40 F = -40 C.

name: AR500
source: CMC Impact Metals, TruWEAR AR500F Plate, QMS TD-CUS-414, last revision 2023-10-01 https://www.cmc.com/getmedia/3ea2e5de-1089-4f07-96e6-9e9ce32ce68d/TruWEAR-500F-Plate.pdf
test_method: Surface Brinell HBW (aim 500 HBW, tested on each plate); Charpy V-notch at -40 F, longitudinal, full-size equivalent, for information only
notes: Transverse Charpy published as 29.8 J at -40 F. Producer states use in mining, asphalt, concrete and aggregate industries. Plate up to 12.7 mm thick.

name: Hadfield manganese steel
source: Metallographic.com (PACE Technologies), 'Hadfield manganese steel' (ASTM A128 Grade B-1) https://metallographic.com/materials/hadfield-manganese-steel
notes: Source page was taken offline (checked 2026-10-12); value known only from a search-result summary. Surface work-hardens to >500 HB under impact and abrasion per the same summary.

name: Ni-Hard 4
source: Wilfley, NiHard 4 material sheet (ASTM A532 Class I Type D) https://wilfley.com/lit/materials/nihard-4-hard-iron.pdf
test_method: Average Brinell hardness (HBN); method and section size not stated
notes: Pump producer's datasheet for its own castings. Range is the published average hardness, not the ASTM A532 minimum.

name: High-chromium white iron
typical_applications: crusher liners;chute liners;ball mill liners;lifter bars;slurry pumps;impellers
source: Penticton Foundry, Alloy data sheet: high chrome white iron 25% (ASTM A532 Class III Type A) https://www.pentictonfoundry.com/news/alloy-data-sheet-25-high-chromium-alloy/
test_method: Brinell, hardened condition, varies with section thickness; density published as 0.26 lb/in3 (7.6 g/cm3)

name: Alumina ceramic
source: CoorsTek, Advanced Alumina properties chart, AD-995 (99.5% Al2O3), (c) 2023 CoorsTek 01023 L https://www.coorstek.com/media/4235/advanced-alumina.pdf
test_method: Density in g/cm3; Knoop 1000 gf hardness; fracture toughness K(Ic); typical values, method of manufacture affects values
notes: Brinell is not applicable to technical ceramics; published Knoop (1000 gf) hardness is 14.1 GPa. Fracture toughness published as 4-5 MPa.m^0.5; lower bound stored.

name: Natural rubber
source: Trelleborg, Sheet Rubber Products for the Mining Industry (brochure 9372), BLACKROCK PLUS (NR) https://www.trelleborg.com/fluidhandling/-/media/fluid-handling-solutions/tepa/brochure/9372-trelleborg-sheet-rubber-products-for-the-mining-industry.pdf
test_method: Hardness Shore A per ASTM D2240; specific gravity 1.12 (method not stated)
notes: Single published hardness value (no tolerance stated), stored as min = max. Working temperature -50 to +85 C. Tensile >= 18 MPa (ISO 37).

name: Polyurethane
source: NUBA Screening Media, NUBA Technical Advice section 6: Polyurethane Screens https://www.nubasm.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/6_Mallas-Poliuretano_ENG_mail.pdf
test_method: Shore A range is the possible formulation range (method not stated); density stated as approximate
notes: Mining screen-panel PU (polyester and polyether systems). Density printed as '1.210 Kg/m3', read as 1210 kg/m3; see docs/DATA_TODO.md.
